description: Ranked El Niño ski resorts from SnowSure's 30-year fleet table. Filter by region (south-america, north-america, europe, asia, oceania) or tier (A prime / B favored / C ENSO-proof / D late bloomer / E timing play). Use for 'best El Niño resorts in Europe', 'where will it snow most in 2026-27', 'is El Niño good for the Alps'.

limit.description: How many resorts to return (default 10, max 50).

region.description: Optional region: south-america, north-america, europe, asia, oceania, or colloquial (andes, alps, japan, rockies).

tier.description: Optional tier letter or label: A/prime, B/favored, C/enso-proof, D/late bloomer, E/timing.

name: get_elnino_rankings

markdown.description: Human-readable markdown summary of the tool result (may be omitted when structuredContent carries a typed payload; content[0].text always has the prose).

title: El Niño rankings
